scenarios.name: dampers_open_few_reheating
scenarios.description: Reference vector: 75% of zones above the high-open damper threshold with 10% reheating — cooling starvation with nobody reheating; alarms after alarm_delay (1800 s), served in full from load because delayOnInit is true

scenarios.name: dampers_moderate_few_reheating
scenarios.description: Reference vector: 45% of zones wide open with 10% reheating — light reheat alone is not a finding; the damper population never clears its threshold

scenarios.name: dampers_open_widespread_reheat
scenarios.description: Reference vector: 75% of zones wide open but 40% reheating — a mixed-load hour, not warm supply air; PNNL-27338 forbids lowering the setpoint here

scenarios.name: damper_fraction_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: the open-damper fraction sits exactly on damper_fraction_threshold (0.60) with 10% reheating — the strict `>` keeps it out of the alarm

scenarios.name: reheat_fraction_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: exactly a quarter of zones reheating (0.25) against 75% wide-open dampers — the strict `<` means the fraction must fall below the threshold

scenarios.name: morning_pulldown_clears_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: the pull-down signature — every damper open, nothing reheating — relaxes to 0.40 open at t=1200, inside alarm_delay, so no alarm

scenarios.name: reheat_returns_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: dampers stay at 0.75 but the reheating fraction climbs back to 0.35 at t=1200 — the corroborating conjunct drops out before the alarm can assert

scenarios.name: damper_dip_restarts_persistence
scenarios.description: Transient: the open-damper fraction dips to 0.50 at t=900 and returns to 0.75 at t=1200 — persistence restarts from the return, so the alarm lands at 3000 s, not 1800 s

scenarios.name: reheat_gate_opens_late
scenarios.description: Gate edge: dampers held at 0.75 throughout while the reheating fraction falls from 0.40 to 0.10 at t=900 — persistence starts at the reheat crossing, so the alarm lands at 2700 s

scenarios.name: both_gates_arrive_together
scenarios.description: Gate edge: both conjuncts start false (0.45 open, 0.40 reheating) and both cross at t=600 to 0.80 open and 0.05 reheating — the alarm lands at 2400 s
